import AlgebraicJacobian.Algebra.LaurentNilpotentCoboundary

open Polynomial LaurentPolynomial
namespace ProbePicC5
open AlgebraicGeometry
variable {A : Type} [CommRing A]

-- QUESTION: does my nilpotent result REDUCE the general ring case to the reduced case?
-- Concretely: given a Laurent unit u over A whose image in (A/nil A)[T,T^-1] is a coboundary,
-- is u a coboundary over A?  That is the statement that would make the reduction real.
-- The subtle point: a coboundary UPSTAIRS in the quotient lifts to a unit v*w upstairs;
-- lifting v and w back to A[X] units requires lifting units along a nilpotent surjection --
-- which IS possible (units lift along surjections with nilpotent kernel).  Test that input.
/-- Units are detected modulo a nilpotent kernel. -/
theorem isUnit_of_isUnit_map {R S : Type} [CommRing R] [CommRing S] (φ : R →+* S)
    (hs : Function.Surjective φ) (hker : RingHom.ker φ ≤ nilradical R) (r : R)
    (h : IsUnit (φ r)) : IsUnit r := by
  obtain ⟨t, ht⟩ := hs ((h.unit⁻¹ : Sˣ) : S)
  have h1 : φ (r * t) = 1 := by
    rw [map_mul, ht]
    calc φ r * ((h.unit⁻¹ : Sˣ) : S)
        = ((h.unit : Sˣ) : S) * ((h.unit⁻¹ : Sˣ) : S) := by rw [IsUnit.unit_spec]
      _ = 1 := by rw [← Units.val_mul, mul_inv_cancel, Units.val_one]
  have hnil : IsNilpotent (r * t - 1) := hker (by simp [RingHom.mem_ker, map_sub, h1])
  have hru : IsUnit (r * t) := by simpa using hnil.isUnit_one_add (R := R)
  exact isUnit_of_mul_isUnit_left hru

-- Is ker(A[X] → (A/nil A)[X]) ≤ nilradical A[X]?  That is the remaining input.
example (p : Polynomial A)
    (h : Polynomial.mapRingHom (Ideal.Quotient.mk (nilradical A)) p = 0) :
    IsNilpotent p := by
  rw [Polynomial.isNilpotent_iff]
  intro i
  have hi : (Ideal.Quotient.mk (nilradical A)) (p.coeff i) = 0 := by
    have := congrArg (fun z => Polynomial.coeff z i) h
    simpa using this
  exact (Ideal.Quotient.eq_zero_iff_mem).mp hi

end ProbePicC5
